text:
Maria G: Quick async standup — api gateway / routing / auth / rate limits. TL;DR: small canary 3% rolled, saw a thin spike of 429s on bursty paths. What I did: rolled canary, checked dashboards, paused a couple failing routes. Blockers: need a short config tweak for token-bucket smoothing. Today: propose patch + small canary rollback plan if needed.

Ajay Patel: Thanks — can you paste the 429 sig? is it per-route or global?

Maria G: Per-route (ingress routes: /v1/generate and /v1/chat mainly). CPU looked fine, backpressure from per-tenant token buckets. 429s aligned with 1–2s client bursts. Link to spike chart: https://redwood.app/d/ingress/spikes?panelId=12

Samir K: Noted. Sounds like token burst settings too strict. We added a smoothing param last quarter but maybe default is too aggressive for low-latency flows.

Jen L: Which config file do we tweak? Is this the global ratepolicy or the per-route override?

Maria G: Per-route overrides. Example snippet (staging):
```yaml
routes:
  - path: /v1/generate
    rate_bucket:
      refill_tokens: 100
      capacity: 200
      smooth_window_ms: 800
```
We want to bump smooth_window_ms to 1200 for that route and increase capacity by 20% for a short canary.

Ajay Patel: Sounds reasonable. I can author PR. Will target small rollout to 3% for 30m, monitor 429 rate and tail latency. PR draft: #4139. cc @Samir K for review.

Samir K: Reviewing — quick thought: also add a fallback policy to route requests to a lower-cost model variant rather than returning 429 if capacity hit. That buys us graceful degradation. I'll add a comment in the PR.

Kai (oncall): FYI I'll keep oncall watch for the next 2h. If we see >0.5% 429s on those routes we rollback. Also, add a deploy-bot check to enforce canary sizing.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout scheduled: PR #4139 -> canary 3% -> window 30m. Notifying: @Kai (oncall), @Maria G.

Maria G: Thanks. Blocker resolved (PR in flight). Minor ask: Ajay, can you include a tiny smoke test that simulates 1–2s bursts (kinda like the C++ client does) so we can validate smoothing?

Ajay Patel: Yep — adding a simple k6 script to the PR. Snippet:
```bash
k6 run --vus 20 --duration 60s burst-test.js
```
Will run in staging and paste results.

Jen L: Quick heads-up — I have a pending auth KID rotation scheduled for 18:30 UTC. If you hit any auth rejects during canary, that's probably me. I'll pin a message in #incidents when I start.

Maria G: Good call. Let's avoid overlapping windows. Ajay — can you start the canary at 19:15 UTC (earlier than KID rotation)?

Ajay Patel: Can do. Scheduling now.

Samir K: One more tiny item: add metric-based alert for prefix cache hit rate drop >5% during rollout. If caching drops, that may amplify token usage.

Maria G: Adding to rollout checklist. Thanks team. Will post short summary once PR merges. :thumbsup:

Kai (oncall): I'll be on standby. Ping me in thread if we hit >0.2% 429s.

deploy-bot: Canary started for PR #4139 at 1769902200 (3% traffic). Monitoring panels enabled.
